note: Rare Crops that drop from harvesting in the Greenhouse, and the one stat that changes their odds. These are not the Harvest Bounty table on the Greenhouse page - that is a separate roll behind the Bonus Drops effect, and it lives in the scrape. These drop from breaking any plant with a Harvestable status, at a flat rate per plant, whatever the plant is.
source: Hypixel Wiki: Fermento#Greenhouse, Helianthus#Greenhouse, Cropie#Greenhouse, Squash#Greenhouse, Overbloom#Mechanics, Rare Crop.
basisNote: Each page says the roll is per 'crop or mutation with a Harvestable status' broken, so it is per plant and not per crop item. The planner counts the mutations it harvests. The base crops of the ring are harvestable too and would each roll again, which this does not count - the ring is modelled as a cost rather than a crop, so the rare-crop income here is a floor.
overbloomSource: Overbloom#Mechanics states it outright, for Rare Crops generally. Every page below repeats 'The chance can be increased by Overbloom'.
armourNote: The sets are mutually exclusive and the best one does NOT drop everything. Cropie needs Tater armour and Squash needs Cropie armour, and both pages carry the same line under Bugs: the drop does not happen in the Greenhouse while wearing Fermento or Helianthus armour. So a maxed farmer in Helianthus gets Fermento and Helianthus and neither of the other two. Cropie and Squash are listed here with their rates so the omission is visible rather than silent, and are off by default.
defaultSetNote: The set a maxed farmer is actually in. It is also the one with the lower rates - Tater's Cropie at 20% a plant is worth far more per harvest than Fermento's 2.8% - which is a real choice the page can show rather than make.
overbloomNote: Zero until told otherwise. It comes off equipment, reforges, enchantments and pets rather than anything the API publishes as a stat, so it is a box like Farming Fortune. It rarely changes, so it is worth typing once.
